learning_outcomes.text: has detailed knowledge of data mining and data processing
knows the methods, techniques and tools used in solving engineering tasks in the area of data mining
Can obtain information from literature, databases and other sources necessary to solve data mining tasks
Can assess, at a basic level, the usefulness of routine IT methods and tools and select and apply the appropriate method and tools to solve data mining tasks

syllabus_topics: Initial data preparation for data mining processes
Introduction to classification problems, division of the data set into training and testing sets
Rule classifiers, simple tree classifiers, decision tree induction methods
Classifiers in the form of neural networks
Discovery of association rules and their algorithms. Algorithms for finding frequent sets and associations, basket analysis

assessment_methods.method: Verifying assumed learning outcomes by assessing knowledge and skills demonstrated during the performance of problem tasks

degree: Computer Science / ICT (Institute of Informatics) - courses in English for exchange students
